symptom: The public homepage and last-minute rails show branded skeletons and then a retry error instead of real cards; switching tabs can repeat the failure.
expected_behavior: Every selected rail reaches a terminal verified state with real cards or a verified empty result, while the previous verified cards stay visible during a tab refresh.
environment: Public https://vii.spaplus.co on 2026-11-13, deployed app build dbdcc6b8-211e-d11b-78e3-ff9449f8030d, independently reproduced in a clean Playwright desktop context and corroborated by the user's desktop and iPhone screenshots.

steps: Open the public homepage in a clean browser context.
Scroll to the near-date and holiday rails.
Observe both rails for more than ten seconds and query their public JSON endpoints repeatedly.
reproduction.evidence: At 1s, 6s and 16s both rails had zero cards; they changed from aria-busy skeletons to the retry error. The corresponding APIs repeatedly returned HTTP 200 with availabilityStatus=refreshing and zero deals.

observations.observation: Commit 8c40a512 reduced both cold server snapshot join budgets from 4800ms to 350ms and reduced the homepage browser request budget from 5500ms to 2500ms.
observations.evidence: git diff 8c40a512^ 8c40a512 for app/api/vii/home-deals/route.ts, app/api/vii/home-holiday-deals/route.ts and app/components/home-live-deals.tsx.

observations.observation: The 350ms route returns refreshing and delegates the still-pending snapshot to waitUntil, but repeated public requests continue to see refreshing rather than the newly durable snapshot.
observations.evidence: Repeated production reads on 2026-11-13 returned X-VII-Discovery-Cache=refreshing, availabilityStatus=refreshing and zero deals.

observations.observation: The earlier cold-path measurement required about 5.9 seconds before a verified 50-deal holiday snapshot existed.

hypotheses.mechanism: The server returns after 350ms before the lease-owned provider operation commits, and post-response continuation is not reliably completing in this public runtime; the 2500ms browser budget then repeats observations until the shared deadline becomes a false terminal error.
hypotheses.prediction: Clean browsers and direct API calls will reproduce refreshing with zero deals, and the regression will align with the 350ms/2500ms budget change.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare fresh-browser terminal state, repeated API responses and the introducing commit.
hypotheses.result: All three align: independent browser failure, repeated refreshing API responses and the exact budget regression in 8c40a512.

hypotheses.mechanism: The failure is only stale browser cache on Adir's devices.
hypotheses.prediction: A clean independent browser and no-store API reads will succeed.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Reproduce in a clean Playwright context and inspect no-store API responses.
hypotheses.result: The clean context and no-store responses reproduced the failure.

hypotheses.mechanism: The supplier has no valid inventory for the selected dates.
hypotheses.prediction: The API will return a verified empty state rather than a refreshing state, and previous measurements will not produce deals.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare status semantics and the prior exact cold-to-warm sequence.
hypotheses.result: The API remained refreshing and the earlier exact flow produced 50 verified deals, so absence of inventory is not the mechanism.

fix.change: For missing snapshots, give the single lease-owned server refresh a 6500ms bounded join and give the browser transport 7500ms, while warm and stale snapshots remain immediate. Apply the same boundary to near-date, homepage holiday and dedicated holiday clients.
fix.evidence: Source patch prepared; post-fix local and public evidence is not yet complete.

affected_family: Homepage near-date rail and all tabs
Homepage holiday rail and all tabs
Dedicated holiday audience and period controls
Mobile Safari, Android Chrome and desktop
remaining_unknowns: Post-fix production terminal-state evidence has not yet been collected.
The scheduler's coverage of every future holiday key still needs separate production evidence.
authorization_boundary: Adir authorized causal repair, production publication and exact post-publication verification for the slider and loading failure.
